on_session_start.inject_scope: Session-scoped: injected once when the session starts, after extensions have loaded, and appended to the system prompt for the remainder of the session. Contrast before_message, which is re-evaluated per turn.

host_context_keys.project_root: RESERVED host-owned value: the canonical trusted project root the host discovers ONCE from its own working directory (nearest .git/.synaps-project marker, canonicalized). Entries declaring host_context are resolved EXCLUSIVELY from host state — env overrides, secret_env, plugin config, and legacy config keys are all skipped — and the value is injected into the resolved config sent at initialize (retained in deferred launch records). Never forwarded as an environment variable; user or model input can never supply or widen it.

validation: key must be non-empty and must not contain dots, slashes, or spaces
required must be boolean when present
secret_env must be an environment variable name when present
host_context, when present, must be a known host-context key and must not be combined with secret_env

theme_tokens.compatibility: additive optional field within extension_protocol_version 1 (no version bump; per docs/STABILITY.md §1, extensions and hosts must tolerate its absence — manifests without it behave exactly as before)
override_order: unset (host renders with its base tokens)
validation: token must be non-empty and must not contain dots, slashes, or spaces
value must be a hex color: "#rgb" or "#rrggbb"
name must be non-empty and unique per extension
input_schema must be a JSON object

provider.complete.note: Effective timeout is 30s: an outer 60s guard wraps the generic request path, which itself times out non-tool.call methods at 30s.

provider.stream.events: provider.stream.event notifications, forwarded to the caller's sink until the provider.stream response resolves

deferred_lifecycle.compatibility: additive optional field within extension_protocol_version 1 (no version bump): manifests WITHOUT it keep the documented legacy EAGER lifecycle byte-for-byte, in every host mode; hosts that predate it ignore it
deferred_lifecycle.shape: object { tools?: [{name, description (non-empty), input_schema}], providers?: [RegisteredProviderSpec-compatible {id, display_name, description (non-empty), models: [{id, display_name?, capabilities?, context_window?}], config_schema?}], lifecycle?: "hook"|"user" }
semantics: declarations are trusted LOCAL manifest expectations, validated (bounded non-empty names/descriptions, bounded schemas, unique ids, no ':' in tool/provider ids, capability flags boolean) BEFORE any spawn; any violation fails the whole manifest closed

permission coupling: non-empty deferred.tools REQUIRES the 'tools.register' permission and non-empty deferred.providers REQUIRES 'providers.register'; lifecycle="hook" REQUIRES at least one hook subscription — all enforced during manifest validation, before any spawn or catalog registration

under progressive tool disclosure, EVERY manifest with a deferred block defers its process: tool-only manifests catalog dormant descriptor tools (searchable, exactly activatable, execution-gated) with zero process/network; provider manifests register declared provider METADATA behind a lazy handler; hook manifests register permission-validated subscriptions behind a lazy handler; lifecycle="user" manifests stay dormant until an explicit user API (sidecar/commands/settings)

the spawn happens only on the class's legitimate trigger: gate-authorized exact tool execution, first SELECTED provider complete/stream, first AUTHORIZED matching hook event, or an explicit user action; discovery, load, search, and diagnostics never spawn

at initialize, the runtime's registered tools must match the declarations EXACTLY (same name set, canonical schema digest, description) and its registered providers must match the declared provider metadata EXACTLY (ids, display names, descriptions, model ids/display/context windows/capability values, config schemas); any mismatch shuts the child down and fails closed before registration, grant, or route

runtime leases are session-scoped, single-flight per plugin, capacity/idle bounded, and terminated on session end, revocation, unload, or launch-record drift; drift/mismatch classes also revoke exactly the affected session tool grants — transport-transient failures never revoke
lifecycle="user" declares user-triggered-only and CONFLICTS (fails validation) with declared tools/providers; lifecycle="hook" defers start to the first authorized subscribed event
classification: no declarations => legacy_eager; tools => tool_only; providers => provider; hooks/lifecycle=hook => hook_lifecycle; lifecycle=user => ui_sidecar; multiple => mixed

mixed manifests share ONE child process across their capabilities and start on the EARLIEST legitimately required trigger (hook event, then provider selection, then exact tool activation); tool SEARCH alone never starts a process
deferred_lifecycle.flag_off: when progressive tool disclosure is off, every manifest — with or without deferred — loads on the legacy eager path unchanged

legacy_aliases.shape: extension-level `tools: [{name, description, input_schema}]` plus optional `activation: "deferred"` (pre-native manifests such as axel-memory-manager 0.1)
semantics: folded into the native `deferred.tools` block at deserialization, BEFORE any classification or validation — a legacy tool-declaring manifest can never silently load eager
`activation` values other than "deferred" fail the manifest closed (no unknown-activation fallback)
declaring both a native `deferred` block and a legacy alias is ambiguous and fails closed
`activation: "deferred"` without legacy tools declarations fails closed
